children: INNOVATIVE DESIGNS INC reported third-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $758247 up 23.9% from $612636 a year earlier, and net income of $56026 versus $62436 in the prior-year quarter; diluted earnings per share were $0.01(basic and diluted) compared with $0.001 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $758,247 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with $612,636 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 23.9%.
Net income was $56,026 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with $62,436 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (10.3%).
Diluted EPS was $0.01 for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (basic and diluted), compared with $0.001 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue growth for the nine months was 12.6% to $2.20M, driven solely by increased HouseWrap sales.
Company attributed momentum to expanded HouseWrap distribution and is shifting focus toward the building-material channel.
Took delivery of Insultex production equipment with deposits of $662,944; installation and regulatory compliance remain pending.
SG&A increased partly due to hiring a consultant to boost sales (noted as the son of the former CEO engaged in 2024).
